paragraphs: The XE P300 uses the AJ200P — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine from Jaguar Land Rover's Ingenium family. It was fitted from the model's 2015 launch through to the present day across the X760 generation, representing the top-output variant in the XE's petrol range.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ200P engines for every XE P300 on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol Ingenium unit fitted to the XE P300 from 2015 to the present day. No specific known issue confirmed for this application. We replace timing chain components, bearings and gaskets as standard on every AJ200P rebuild.
